response.rationale: R4 is directly anchored to the diagnostic biopsy: LM shows necrosis with a fibrocellular crescent and EM confirms focal segmental necrotising immune-complex GN with subendothelial deposits, supported by immune-complex immunohistology. C1 is an append-only completion of R4 with no additional raw span, so it is discounted as a correlated restatement. R3 captures the LVAD infection but not endocarditis, R5 is contradicted by immune-complex deposits and low C3, and R2 only reflects chronic damage.

rejected.why: Chronic tubulointerstitial damage is a secondary chronic finding; the acute necrotising crescentic GN is the primary diagnosis.
Biopsy shows immune-complex deposits (IgM/C1q/C3, subendothelial) and low C3, not pauci-immune ANCA-associated vasculitis.
